intro: I'm a student at GUTECH in Karachi, studying computer science. I picked up mechatronics and Arduino at The Lab School, and I like building things that actually work: robots that follow lines and push opponents out of a ring, a water level controller, and parts I design myself in Tinkercad and print on a 3D printer.

I work with Chaajao (https://www.chaajao.com), an educational platform. I helped build version 2.0, researched new features, and helped design the app and web version in Figma. I also shoot, edit and publish videos and posts for Chaajao SAT's social media channels.

Robotics competitions have been a big part of my journey. I represented Pakistan at the FIRST Global Challenge in 2020, volunteered at Robotron 1.0 and 2.0, and came back to Robotron '26 as an organizer and event judge.
strengths: Applied Machine Learning for accessibility and real-world problem-solving
WordPress site development, custom management, and web services integration
End-to-end multimedia production, from photography/videography to post-processing

projects.title: Line Following Robot
projects.description: Autonomous line following robot of the kind used in robotics competitions such as Robotron and Edvon, using an Arduino, an L298 motor driver module and a front-mounted line sensor array.
projects.outcome: Competition-style robot, as seen at events like Robotron and Edvon.

projects.title: Robo Sumo Bot
projects.description: Compact, heavy sumo robot with a black body, front wedge, grippy green wheels, two IBT-2 motor driver boards and an Arduino Uno.

projects.title: Robo Race Car
projects.description: Four-wheel-drive racing robot on a clear acrylic chassis with four geared motors driven through an L298 module and an Arduino Uno.

projects.title: DIY Generator
projects.description: Hand-built electric generator made from nails and copper wire coils, built to understand electromagnetic induction.

projects.title: 3D Design & Printing
projects.description: Learned to design parts in Tinkercad and print them on a Bambu Lab A1 3D printer, including enclosures, brackets, a custom nameplate and a lettered cube.
projects.outcome: Can take an idea from a Tinkercad model to a finished print.

projects.title: Affinity Diagram: Hospital Emergency Room Study
projects.description: Design thinking project where my team grouped observations of a public hospital emergency room into themes with an affinity diagram, then turned them into Point-of-View statements and How-Might-We questions.
projects.outcome: Turned scattered observations into focused problems worth solving.

projects.title: AI Assistant for Deaf Community
projects.description: Designed and developed a machine learning model to bridge communication gaps for deaf individuals, interpreting gestures or visual inputs into actionable data.
projects.outcome: Successfully demonstrated applied AI in assistive technology for social impact.

projects.title: Automatic Water Level Sensing Machine
projects.description: Engineered an automated hardware solution using Arduino and ultrasonic/fluid sensors to monitor and control water levels dynamically.
projects.outcome: Prevented water overflow and automated pump control for efficient resource usage.

projects.title: WordPress Web Solutions & Media Production
projects.description: Developed custom WordPress websites integrated with tailored digital media, custom photography, and promotional video content.
projects.outcome: Delivered cohesive digital brand experiences combining clean web setups with professional visual media.

achievements.title: Selected to represent Pakistan at the FIRST Global Challenge
achievements.description: My school and I were selected to represent Pakistan at the FIRST Global Challenge in the Technical Challenge on 14 August 2020. We built a Rube Goldberg machine to transport a ball from one point to another using a 3D printed car, marbles, an air blower and a water turbine, and placed 15th on the Global Leaderboard.
